info.title: arch-linter-net — architecture contract linter for .NET
info.description: .NET tool for running ArchLinterNet architecture contracts from YAML policies. Supports strict and audit modes with human and JSON output.

options.name: --config
options.description:
Path to YAML contract file
(default: architecture/dependencies.arch.yml)

options.name: --output
options.description: Path to write the generated baseline file (required)

options.name: --mode
options.description: Contract mode: strict, audit, or all (default: all)

options.name: --reason
options.description:
Reason text for baseline entries
(default: "generated baseline")

options.name: --condition-set
options.description:
Use a named condition set from analysis.condition_sets
to control conditional compilation symbols during
Roslyn source analysis (default: policy
default_condition_set, otherwise empty symbol set)

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help message
Exit codes:
0   Baseline generated successfully
2   Runtime error (invalid arguments, file not found, config violations, etc.)

options.name: --policy
options.description:
Path to YAML contract file
(default: architecture/dependencies.arch.yml)

options.name: --mode
options.description: Validation mode: strict or audit (default: strict)

options.name: --contract
options.description: Run only the contract with the given ID (may be repeated)

options.name: --condition-set
options.description:
Use a named condition set from analysis.condition_sets
to control conditional compilation symbols during
Roslyn source analysis (default: policy default_condition_set,
otherwise empty symbol set)

options.name: --timings
options.description: Print phase-level timing report to stderr

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: human or json (default: human)

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version
Exit codes:
0   All contracts passed
1   One or more contracts failed
2   Runtime error (invalid arguments, file not found, etc.)
